name: PHLEGETHON
description: Phlegethon is new, named for the river of fire: a slab of cooling magma, black crust plates split by molten cracks that run white-hot towards the bottom, the name standing in the lava with a moat of fire round every letter. It plays the "Black Go" capture of the Gojira X plugin.
pack: Black And Blue NAM Profiles (Black Go)
